goal: Finish assembling Courier itself into one coherent, daily-usable autonomous coordination system
lesson: Always ensure class methods are properly indented within the class block, and that DEDUPED tasks properly read from the cache and transition to VERIFIED.
reusable_pattern: When using early-return cached execution (DEDUPED), the dispatcher must actively retrieve the existing result payload from disk to satisfy downstream planners.
root_cause: process_next_mission was at module scope and CourierSafetyDispatcher didn't handle DEDUPED successfully

goal: FIRST REAL PRODUCT MISSION — BUILD THE FOUNDATION OF A NEXT-GENERATION SOCIAL PLATFORM
lesson: Starting a modular python-based core using dataclasses guarantees zero external dependencies (no pydantic needed initially) allowing cheap/fast deterministic tests in the CLI1 phase.
reusable_pattern: When bootstrapping backend foundations, use stdlib dataclasses for models to avoid dependency blockers, maintaining testing agility during rapid iteration.
task: Design and implement initial product data foundation

error: Goal safety constraints triggered HUMAN_GATE. Dedupe failed to unblock loop.
lesson: Intent-aware gates should strip out negated keywords and boundary declarations before parsing. Resubmitting an active goal must reset BLOCKED/HUMAN_GATE queue missions to PENDING and the goal itself to PENDING.
reusable_pattern: When applying safety keyword checks, use negative lookbehinds or structured removal of constraint phrases. In single-reader task queues, semantic continuation means demoting blocked/failed terminal states back to ready states.
root_cause: _requires_human_gate naively matched keywords in the goal constraints. submit_goal deduped to ACTIVE goals but didn't set them back to PENDING.
task: Fix false-positive HUMAN_GATE and goal continuation dedupe

lesson: explicit deterministic acceptance intent must survive planning transitions
reusable_pattern: validate write contracts at planner boundary and preserve explicit acceptance data end-to-end
root_cause: Structured explicit file intent was not recognized by the planner contract parser
